method.scope: Posthoc descriptive same-trained-AR-weight interventions; no optimizer/update, fitting or efficacy gate
method.variants: half_ring preserves ownA/R multiset but changes spatial association; patch_mean_FP32 collapses within-patch R variation and retains FP32-rounded patch mean; FIT_mean_FP64 makes consumed R axis exactly0
method.limitations: FIT_mean is NOT a retrained A_only control; A itself contains radius-dependent geometry. Nonlinear intervention effects are not an additive variance decomposition.
method.whole: Original metric aggregation: patch-equal within case then case equal; fine sum covered/sum nodes within case, not mean patch fine ratios
method.regional_counts: Regional TP/FP/FN are patch means within each case, then case-equal means, including0-count regions of selected patches
method.regional_BCE: Sum BCE_sum/sum real_CT_voxels within each case, then mean of defined cases; never pooled across cases or mean of patch BCE
method.region: Minimum grid-index distance to six actual observed patch/cache-intersection faces:0..15,16..31,>=32; padding excluded; no regional skeleton, Dice or anatomical wall claims
method.dependence: Same12 TRAIN cases/overlapping patches; R15 primary fine-node count27 may repeat anatomical nodes; no patient/zero-shot independence
method.precision: Whole count/derived metrics match prior endpoints; only nonnegative BCE parity permits up to2 binary64 ULP; no old voxelwise mask parity claim; regional BCE partition closure uses1e-12 relative/absolute FP64 reduction tolerance with exact-zero agreement
